title: Rembarrnga language — Grokipedia
text: Rembarrnga (also spelled Rembarunga) is a severely endangered Australian Aboriginal language belonging to the Gunwinyguan family within the non-Pama–Nyungan group, spoken by the Rembarrnga people in central Arnhem Land, Northern Territory.

title: Rembarrnga — Grokipedia
text: Unlike many Australian languages, Rembarrnga lacks phonemic vowel length distinctions, though contextual lengthening occurs in open syllables or under prosodic prominence.
